model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of public spending within Germany across several categories during the years 2014 and 2021. The chart contains twelve slices representing different areas of expenditure, with the largest slice, “Übrige” (31.1%), followed by “Wohnungsversorgung” (7.2%), “Verkehr” (3.7%), and “Abwasserentsorgung” (3.4%). The remaining slices represent “Wirtschaftsförderung” (4.5%), “Kliniken” (4.7%), “Kombinierte Versorgung” (5.5%), “Stromversorgung” (8.9%), “Gasversorgung” (8.8%), “Abfallwirtschaft” (4.2%), “übliche Versorgung” (6.2%), “4,4,1,4” (1.3%), “4,5” (6.2%), “3,2” (3.2%), and “2,2 Kultur” (2.2%).  Percentage labels are displayed within each slice, and a legend is present, indicating the color associated with each category. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their angular size.
